title: ADR 0005 markdown doc: ledger schema PRD-v1
body_md: CHOICES (G-0001) and many ledger rows reference 'ADR 0005' (schema split: kind/class/urgency, polymorphic deliveries) but docs/adr/ only contains 0001-0004. File the long-form ADR doc capturing context/alternatives/consequences for the schema migration already merged. Single commit adding docs/adr/0005-ledger-schema-prd-v1.md. Anchor reading per U-0008.
evidence_md: ADR docs/adr/0005-ledger-schema-prd-v1.md added (commit e0472de) capturing kind/class/urgency split + polymorphic deliveries decision per U-0008; PR #30 open.
